blocks.content: While CACP recommends Minimum Support Prices, FCI is the operational agency responsible for procuring and distributing foodgrains across India.

rows: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
Procurement, storage, transport, and distribution of food grains
Operational implementation of national food security and PDS
Price policy reports and MSP recommendations for 22 crops

items: CACP only recommends MSPs; the final decision is made by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) chaired by the Prime Minister.
FCI comes under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, whereas CACP comes under the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare.
CACP was originally formed as the Agricultural Prices Commission in 1965 and was renamed to CACP in 1985.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: FCI (Food Corporation of India) is a statutory corporation established under the Food Corporation Act, 1964.
CACP (Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices) is an attached office of the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare.
CACP recommends Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for 22 mandated crops and Fair & Remunerative Price (FRP) for sugarcane.
FCI functions as the main operational agency responsible for procurement, storage, buffer stocking, and public distribution of foodgrains.
Final MSP decisions based on CACP recommendations are approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA).
